title: Corzelius House, 85 Deshler Avenue, Columbus, Franklin County, OH
notes: Significance: The Corzelius House is located in the historical district of German Village in Columbus, Ohio at 85 Deshler Street, South of Schiller Park. During the 1890's Deshler Street was known as the "Dutch Broadway" section of German Village because of the elegant houses built along it by successful German ("Deutsch") immigrants. It is a 2 story brick structure with timber framed gabled roof and rusticated limestone foundation, built in 1894.
